summary: unarchive returns dest info (owner, group, ids, mode, size, state), the files list when list_files is on, the handler used, and the src path used.
questions: Which tool did unarchive use to extract?
How do I see the files extracted by unarchive?

answer_card.title: unarchive return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `files` (with `list_files: true`)
- `handler`: extractor used
- `src`: archive path (temp location if downloaded/copied)
- `dest`, `owner`/`uid`, `group`/`gid`, `mode`, `size`, `state`
